classes.definition: A portable computer with a screen and permanently attached hinged keyboard base visible as one device.
A standalone desktop computer chassis that houses the primary computing components and is separate from its display.
A standalone electronic display intended primarily as a computer or external display, excluding integrated all-in-one computers.
A device whose functions include producing physical printed output, including multifunction printer-scanner-copiers.
A digital video or data projector designed to cast an image onto a separate viewing surface.

non_class_outcomes.definition: The image is readable, but a candidate device or its target class cannot be resolved reliably.
The image is readable and contains no defensible instance of the five target classes.
Image quality, corruption, obstruction, or cropping prevents reliable target-instance annotation.
